comparison.objective: Store a knife in an obstructed holder after safely removing a toy.
comparison.physical_skill: Clear an obstruction, then perform narrow-slot blade insertion with controlled pose and speed.
comparison.success_condition: Knife inserted 140–157 mm with bounded alignment and speed, toy safely released outside holder, both TCPs clear, held 1 s.
comparison.reason: Obstacle removal and precision slot insertion do not test particle-size separation. No material rubric detail is missing.
